PayNet privacy policy
Updated 2 November 2026

What stays on your device
PayNet stores your selected bank and SIM, appearance preferences, payment attempts and bank-message payment outcomes locally. Transaction history is encrypted at rest. Payment records are not uploaded. This build includes internet access for optional installation reporting. If you agree, PayNet sends a random installation ID and app version once when online. The collector stores a hash of that ID, the reported version and the server receipt date. The connection also exposes your IP address to the server and hosting provider. The install counter does not store it. No payment details, messages, contacts or name are included. There is no advertising or ongoing activity tracking. You can decline or turn off unsent reports in Settings → Installation count. Turning reporting off does not remove an already counted report. Installation reporting is disabled in builds without a configured endpoint. The transaction database, its encryption-key preferences and payment preferences are excluded from Android backup and device transfer.

Permissions
Camera access scans UPI QR codes. A selected QR image is read locally. Contacts access lets you choose a recipient; PayNet does not upload your address book. Calling and phone-state access launch your chosen payment route and guide the call flow. Call-ending access supports the app's end-call control. Draw-over-other-apps access displays the payment guide. Audio controls support call guidance, and vibration provides interaction feedback. You can manage permissions in Android Settings.

UPI IDs and the clipboard
When you choose a QR payment, PayNet may copy its UPI ID to the system clipboard. Cleanup is best-effort and only clears a copy still recognised as PayNet's own. The clipboard is a system feature and other permitted apps may access it. PayNet processes newly received bank SMS only during an active payment window. It does not read your SMS inbox or notification contents. Raw message bodies are not saved; a summary and bank reference are stored locally.

Banking happens outside PayNet
Your mobile operator and bank process the phone/USSD payment session under their own terms. PayNet does not ask for, read or store your UPI PIN. Payment outcomes are inferred from matching bank messages. A missing message does not mean a payment failed. Check your bank if unsure.

Retention and deletion
Local records remain until you use Settings → Clear App Data, clear PayNet's storage in Android Settings or uninstall it. The installation-report state is excluded from backup and transfer. Reinstalling or clearing app storage may count as another installation. Deleting local data cannot cancel a bank transaction or remove records held by your bank or operator.

About this policy
This policy covers this offline Android build of the open-source PayNet project. Source and project contact: https://github.com/rajarshidattapy/paynet. Use the project's issue tracker for questions; do not post UPI PINs, account details or payment records publicly. Any future build that changes data handling must update this policy.
